description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5905015019465 RESISTOR,THERMAL: Line 0001 Qty 127 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0079 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
